methodology: For each region x business-activity (IncomeMain) cell: real respondent count and weighted population (same cells as finscope_region_activity.json), the weighted distribution across FinScope's own financial access strand (fasx: Banked / Other formal non-bank / Informal only / Excluded), and the weighted business-registration rate (D6_4a). No income, turnover, or revenue amount is estimated anywhere in this file -- FinScope 2023 has no such variable. Any mapping from these real cell characteristics to a presumptive-tax category is an illustrative interpretive step performed downstream by the dashboard, not a claim made by this loader.
disclosure_rule: cells (region, zone and national) with fewer than 10 unweighted respondents are suppressed (all estimates and counts null); registration rates with fewer than 10 valid answers are suppressed; estimates whose unweighted numerator is below 10 are kept and flagged low_precision with a 95% CI (reconstructed design)

zones.source: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) and OCGS: The 2022 Tanzania Demographic and Health Survey and Malaria Indicator Survey (TDHS-MIS), sampling procedure: 'To estimate geographic differentials for certain demographic indicators, Tanzania was divided into nine geographic zones.' The survey notes that these zones are not official administrative areas and that the Ministry of Health's Reproductive and Child Health Section uses the same classification; grouping regions into zones gives larger denominators and smaller sampling errors.
zones.note: the dashboard shows the zone cell when a region cell is suppressed (fewer than 10 respondents), and the national cell when the zone cell is suppressed too
